scenarios.name: casts-a-creature-card-face-down-as-a-two-two
scenarios.why: Oracle: {X}: choose a creature card in your hand whose mana cost could be paid by some or all of the mana spent on {X}; you may cast it face down as a 2/2 creature spell without paying its mana cost; activate only as a sorcery. p0 activates Illusionary Mask paying {R}{R}{R}{R} for X = 4 and chooses Hill Giant ({3}{R}, mana value 4): the Giant enters face down as a 2/2 with no abilities rather than a 3/3.
